suppress.notes: Kotlin build tooling; 2.4.10 is the latest stable release.

tika-core 4.0.0 is newer than the fixed 4.0.0-beta-1; dependency-check mis-orders the pre-release qualifier and flags a version that already contains the fix. CVE-2026-66755 is also in the ISA-Tab parser, which ships in tika-parsers - only tika-core is on the classpath. No expiry: 4.0.0 will never stop sorting after 4.0.0-beta-1.
